seo.title: Lasan Marine Co., Ltd. – Naval Architecture & Marine Software
seo.description: Naval architecture and marine software firm in Nha Trang, Vietnam: fishing vessel and passenger boat design, approval documents, custom engineering software.

items.headline: Lasan Marine designs fishing vessels, passenger boats and approval documents
items.lead: From new-build drawings and conversions to plan-approval documents, calculated with engineering software we write ourselves. The same team builds custom software for naval architects and shipyards.

fields.heading: Why owners work with Lasan Marine

items.title: We know fishing vessels and the approval process
items.desc: Documents done to the rules from the start, with clear answers during review.

items.title: Fast, with a clear quote
items.desc: Scope, deliverables and dates agreed before work starts — you know what you get and when.

fields.heading: Outsourcing design or software work to Vietnam?
fields.content: We work remotely in English from Nha Trang (UTC+7), in your templates and standards. We sign an NDA before you share details, and the code and design work we produce for you is yours.

fields.heading: Software for naval architects and shipyards

items.name: Engineering calculation tools
items.desc: Stability, hydrostatics, resistance and power, and structural calculations that also generate the calculation document.

items.name: CAD plugins and automation
items.desc: Rhino/Grasshopper plugins, AutoCAD automation and Maxsurf batch runs for the repetitive steps in design work.

items.name: Web apps for yards and design offices
items.desc: Estimating, material take-off and BOM, drawing and document control built around your own workflow.

items.name: AI agents and workflow automation
items.desc: Rule and standard look-up, drafting of routine technical documents and data extraction, with an engineer in the loop.

fields.heading: Planning a new build, a conversion or a software tool?
fields.description: Send us the vessel type, target size and the documents you have, or describe the task you want automated. We reply with a clear scope and quote.
